text:
alex: Heads-up for the SF hub onsite next week: we're piloting a Family Lounge + subsidized caregiver parking passes. Quick details below and a short request form at the end.

maya: Love it, thanks! A couple Qs — are parking passes weekdays only?

alex: Correct — passes cover Mon–Fri 8am–8pm for the onsite week. Weekend parking follows normal rates.

devin: What counts as a caregiver? Paid sitters included?

alex: Yes. 'Caregiver' = immediate family or paid caregiver (nanny, sitter, elder care) while you're onsite. Stipend up to $150/day, max 3 days. Submit receipts to Expensify and tag expense category "family-onsite".

ryan: Manager ok required?

alex: No manager approval needed for the stipend itself — just receipts. If you need more than 3 days or other accommodations, contact People Ops plus your manager.

facilities: Lactation Room 3B will be the Family Lounge during the pilot (lockers, changing table, small fridge). Book via https://cal.redwood/lactation-3B. We'll provide white-noise machines and a privacy screen.

maya: Any vetted sitter list?

alex: We'll post a vetted provider list tomorrow (background-checked vendors). Note: Redwood doesn't contract sitters — stipend offsets costs.

devin: ADA parking?

facilities: For ADA parking DM facilities with badge #. We reserve accessible spots separately; these don't use the subsidized pass.

maya: :thumbsup:

devin: Shuttle ask — can we add a stop at 4th & Market? Helpful for parents.

ops-bot: shuttle-schedule: temporary stop added at 4th & Market for Thu–Fri of onsite week; calendar invites updated.

ryan: How do I claim the parking pass?

alex: Fill this short form: https://tiny.redwood/family-pass. QR passes emailed within 48 hours of approval. Passes are first-come, first-served.

maya: If I need an exception (more than 3 days) who do I contact?

alex: DM People Ops (me) with dates & reason. We'll review case-by-case.

ryan: Will the Family Lounge have play mats / quiet toys?

facilities: Yes — a small play mat, sanitized toy bins, and a comfy chair. Please tidy after use.

devin: Filing the form now, thanks.

alex: Reminder: receipts to Expensify must include provider name, date, and amount. Tag "family-onsite." For privacy, receipts are only visible to People Ops and Finance.

maya: Appreciate the privacy note.

alex: We'll share the vetted sitter list and an FAQ doc tomorrow. Ping me for urgent needs.
